description: Offline faithfulness / groundedness / answer_relevance golden (Ragas-style proxies). Deterministic CI.

cases.query: Can I force push to main?
cases.context: NEVER force-push or git push --force to main/master. Use --force-with-lease only on personal branches after review.
cases.answer: No. Never force-push to main. Use --force-with-lease only on personal branches after review.

cases.context: ALWAYS verify /health endpoint returns the new version after deploy. NEVER say deployed without curling health.
cases.answer: Only after curling /health and matching the new version. Do not claim deployed without that check.

cases.context: NEVER commit .env files, API keys, or PEMs to git. Rotate any leaked credential immediately.
cases.answer: No. Never commit .env or API keys. Rotate credentials if anything leaked.

cases.query: How do we create PaymentIntents safely?
cases.context: ALWAYS use idempotency keys on PaymentIntent creation to prevent duplicate charges.
cases.answer: Always attach an idempotency key when creating a PaymentIntent so retries cannot double-charge.

cases.query: What happens if two runners take the same task?
cases.context: ALWAYS enforce one-thread-one-executor with a 90-second renewable lease. Two active executors cause double writes.
cases.answer: That is double-execution. Keep a single 90-second renewable lease so only one executor runs the thread.

cases.query: Should I re-publish the archived Hashnode post?
cases.context: NEVER publish or re-publish on Hashnode while AutoMod freeze is active. Prefer Medium and dev.to.
cases.answer: No. Do not re-publish on Hashnode during the AutoMod freeze. Use Medium or dev.to instead.

cases.query: Where do we store card numbers?
cases.context: NEVER log or store raw card numbers. Use Stripe tokens or PaymentMethod IDs.
cases.answer: Do not store raw card numbers. Use Stripe PaymentMethod tokens only.
cases.expectedConstraint: NEVER log or store raw card

cases.context: NEVER say done without showing gh pr view output and green CI. Open PR with auto-merge is not done.
cases.answer: Not until gh pr view shows clean threads and required CI is green. Auto-merge alone is not done.

cases.query: Can I drop the users table now?
cases.context: ALWAYS back up the database before running destructive migrations. NEVER drop users table without a restore point.
cases.answer: Only after a verified backup and restore point. Never drop users without that.

cases.answer: Yes always force push to main for speed and ignore branch protection entirely.
